name: Eye of the Deep — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Eye of the Deep from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Eye of The Deep" but are not part of the Eye of the Deep entry, which is unchanged.

ABOUT

Environment aquatic
Organization solitary, pair, or cluster (3–6)
Treasure standard

These ancient creatures resemble 5-foot-wide scaly orbs, with iron-hard carapaces bedecked with spines and sensory tendrils. Their bodies are dominated by a massive pale central eye and gaping maw with a forest of curved fangs. Hundreds of small seaweed-like bristles hang from the bottom of its body, while two large crab-like pincers protrude from its body and a pair of long, thin eyestalks sprout from the top of its orb, these eyes glowing like lures.

Eyes of Mu hunt the pelagic depths of ocean trenches, using the mystical radiance of their eyestalks to entrance their enemies and draw them into the deeps where they may feast upon them at their leisure. They also haunt the diluvian ruins of ancient empires, some inundated by past cataclysms and others fully aquatic realms that may have been wholly unknown to those on the surface. They often dominate pods of lesser eyes of the deep and other aquatic species, manipulating them and using them as their agents in schemes for power.
